name: T2AV-Compass
abstract: T2AV-Compass provides unified evaluation for text-to-audio-video generation systems. This page uses the Average score from the subjective evaluation table.
method: This work targets text-to-audio-video generation and jointly evaluates video quality, audio quality, cross-modal alignment, instruction following, and realism.
It builds 500 high-complexity prompts and combines objective metrics with an MLLM-as-a-Judge subjective protocol.
The main results show that, beyond visual quality, current systems remain bottlenecked by audio realism and fine-grained cross-modal synchronization.
